title: Eon-class MaleCNS controller-mediated showcase
claim: A full-MaleCNS, controller-mediated, closed-loop engineering demonstration using declared central sensory bridges and body controllers.

contamination-input-ablated.meaning: The dust-to-groom transition requires the registered contamination input.

groom-readout-ablated.meaning: The grooming controller cannot start when its neural readout is silenced.

sucrose-input-ablated.meaning: The feeding-initiation transition requires the registered sucrose input.

mn9-readout-ablated.meaning: The rostrum-extension controller cannot start when MN9 is silenced.

zero-weight.meaning: Recorded as a diagnostic only; it is not a topology-specificity gate.

shuffled-connectome.meaning: Recorded as a diagnostic only because the shuffled and exact networks are not activity matched.
